```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
```


### 1. Ranadom seed setting & Data displaying
```{r}
set.seed(10)

bci <- read.csv("Practical2_bci_communities.csv")

dim(bci)
str(bci)
```

### 2. Exploring the data
```{r}
# 采样样方数量
n_distinct(bci$site_id)

# 物种数量
n_distinct(bci$species)
```

### 3. Andira inermis
```{r}
# 该物种全部50个样方的总个体数
andira_total <- sum(bci$count[bci$speices == "Andira inermis"])
andira_total
```

### 4. Abund
```{r}
abund <- bci %>%
  group_by(species)%>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(count), .groups = "drop")

head(abund)
```

### 5. Most abundant & Less 
```{r}
abund %>% arrange(desc(total_abundance)) %>% head(3)

nrow(abund %>% filter(total_abundance == 1))
```

### 6. Histogram
```{r}
ggplot(abund, aes(x = total_abundance)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#c84242" ,colour="black") +
  labs(x="total_abundance", y="count", titles="Species Distribution") +
  theme_bw()
```

### 7. Oenocarpus mapora
```{r}
om <- bci %>% filter(species == "Oenocarpus mapora")

ggplot(om, aes(x=count)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill="steelblue", colour="black") +
  labs(x="count per subplot", y="Frequenncy") + 
  theme_bw()

ggplot(om, aes(y=count)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill="steelblue") +
  theme_bw()
```

### 8. Comparison between om & pa
```{r}
com <- bci %>%
  filter(species %in% c("Oenocarpus mapora", "Poulsenia armata"))

ggplot(com, aes(x=species, y=count, fill=species)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#348abd", "#E24A33")) +
  labs(x="Speices", y="Number of individuals per subplot") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position="none")
```

### 9. Mean and medium
```{r}
om_mean <- mean(om$count)
pa_mean <- mean(bci$count[bci$speices == "Poulsenia armata"])
om_mean
pa_mean

metrics_df <- com %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abund = mean(count),
    median_abund = median(count),
    .group="drop"
  )
metrics_df
```

### 10. Example of Boxplot
```{r}
dat <- bci[bci$species %in% c("Poulsenia armata", "Oenocarpus mapora"), ]

metrics <- data.frame(
  species = rep(c("Poulsenia armata", "Oenocarpus mapora"), each=2),
  value = c(
    mean(bci$count[bci$species == "Poulsenia armata"]),
    median(bci$count[bci$species == "Poulsenia armata"]),
    mean(bci$count[bci$species == "Oenocarpus mapora"]),
    median(bci$count[bci$species == "Oenocarpus mapora"])
  ),
  metric = rep(c("mean", "median"), 2)
)

ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data=dat, aes(x=species, y=count), fill="grey98") +
  geom_point(data=metrics, aes(x=species, y=value, color=metric, shape=metric), size=5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(19, 17)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin=0.1, end=0.7) +
  xlab("Species") + ylab("Abundance per subplots")
```

### 11. Distribution
```{r}
normA <- rnorm(n=100, mean=0, sd=1)
hist(normA, main="Normal n=100")
abline(v= c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), col=c("green", "blue", "red", "blue", "green"), lwd=2)

normB <- rnorm(n=1000, mean=0, sd=1)
hist(normB, main="Normal n=1000")
abline(v= c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), col=c("green", "blue", "red", "blue", "green"), lwd=2)
```

```{r}
om_mu <- mean(om$count)

om_mu
```


### 14. Tile graph
```{r}
dat <- bci[bci$species %in% c("Poulsenia armata", "Oenocarpus mapora"), ]

ggplot(dat) +
  geom_tile(aes(x_n, y_n, fill=count)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option="magma", direction=-1) +
  facet_wrap(~species) +
  coord_fixed()
```

### 15. Simple random sampling
```{r}
sample_om <- sample(dat$count[dat$species == "Oenocarpus mapora"], 5, replace=FALSE)
sample_pa <- sample(dat$count[dat$species == "Poulsenia armata"], 5, replace=FALSE)

mean(sample_om)
mean(sample_pa)

true_om <- mean(dat$count[dat$species == "Oenocarpus mapora"])
true_pa <- mean(dat$count[dat$species == "Poulsenia armata"])
true_om
true_pa
```

### 16. 100 sampling (n=5)
```{r}
rep = 100
n = 5

om_vec <- numeric(rep)
pa_vec <- numeric(rep)

for(i in 1:rep){
  om_vec[i] <- mean(sample(dat$count[dat$species == "Oenocarpus mapora"], size = n, replace = FALSE))
  pa_vec[i] <- mean(sample(dat$count[dat$species == "Poulsenia armata"], size = n, replace = FALSE))
}

par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(om_vec, main="O.mapora sample means n=5")
abline(v=true_om, col="red", lwd=2)
hist(pa_vec, main="P.armata sample means n=5")
abline(v=true_pa, col="red", lwd=2)
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
```

### 18. Random sample mean
```{r}
randomSampleMean = function(spp, sample_size){
  samp <- c()
  for(i in 1:100){
    samp <- c(samp, mean(sample(bci$count[bci$species == spp], sample_size, replace=FALSE)))
  }
  result <- data.frame(
    species = spp,
    sample_mean = samp,
    sample_size = sample_size
  )
  return(result)
}

pa5  <- randomSampleMean(spp = "Poulsenia armata", sample_size = 5)
pa10 <- randomSampleMean(spp = "Poulsenia armata", sample_size = 10)
pa20 <- randomSampleMean(spp = "Poulsenia armata", sample_size = 20)
pa30 <- randomSampleMean(spp = "Poulsenia armata", sample_size = 30)

om5  <- randomSampleMean(spp = "Oenocarpus mapora", sample_size = 5)
om10 <- randomSampleMean(spp = "Oenocarpus mapora", sample_size = 10)
om20 <- randomSampleMean(spp = "Oenocarpus mapora", sample_size = 20)
om30 <- randomSampleMean(spp = "Oenocarpus mapora", sample_size = 30)

data_for_plot <- do.call(rbind.data.frame,
                         list(pa5, pa10, pa20, pa30, om5, om10, om20, om30))

true_means <- data.frame(
  species = c("Poulsenia armata","Oenocarpus mapora"),
  mean_abund = c(true_pa, true_om)
)

ggplot(data_for_plot)+
  geom_histogram(aes(x=sample_mean, fill=species), bins=25)+
  geom_vline(data=true_means, aes(xintercept=mean_abund), col="darkblue", lty=2, linewidth=1)+
  facet_grid(sample_size~species)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position="none")
```
